steps.text: It's me.
I've reached the target destination. I have visual confirmation of the smoke signal's coordinates.
...It's been a while since our last fight with the other mercenaries. We've taken some losses.
But they hid plenty of supplies in the underground bunker. We won't come back empty-handed.
Mm, yeah. The scout can go on ahead.
I'll catch up soon.
...Right, there was an unexpected casualty.
W is dead.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: You're talking like it was hell on earth out there, but you look perfectly fine to me.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Or are you talking it up to get a pity bonus?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Well, it's not like you had to go out of your way to leave camp to pick us up. Who asked you to be such a worrywart?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: I don't give a shit about anyone. Quit projecting.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: If W hadn't stayed behind to create an opening for us, none of us would've made it out.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...When did it happen?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Two hours ago, when our communications were cut off. The squad got ambushed.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: W blew apart the ruins and gave us a chance to escape. He fought until the bitter end.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Poor guy.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Yeah. If only he made it back to camp alive. His kill count was well past mine. He would've come out as top merc, easy.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Forget it, no point talking about that stuff now. At least he's earned his rest.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: With the enemy routed, we should probably bring him back?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Impossible. We can't risk exposing ourselves like that. Don't want to get caught out.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Why would you even want to? Were you two that close? Nobody told me.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: He had a bunch of loot on him. That's all I care about.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: It wasn't that much. Some of the other guys brought in bigger hauls.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: When the war ends, we can go back to the good old days.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...If the war ends.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: We can sit around and commiserate later. We'd better get out of here before sunset if we don't want to be the center of attention.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Head back to camp and muster the troops.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Hmm—?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Is that an order, 'Second' Lieutenant Hoederer?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...We've lost contact with the other squads. As of right now, I'm your commanding officer.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: We're the same rank.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: *Sigh*....

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...Ines, let's hurry back to the rendezvous point. Then we can contact the client again to renegotiate our deal.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: That's a suggestion, not an order. All right?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: How much you think we can milk W's death for?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: A lot.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: He was a helluva merc. Everybody knew.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: At least... his death won't be in vain.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: In the end, did he leave anything—

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: —Shh!

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Someone's coming. Three o'clock. Not one of ours.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Just one. Get out.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: A Sarkaz...? One of the natives?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: No, wait... You have W's gun and knife in your hands...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Who the hell are you?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Not talking? Then, die.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Wait, hold up.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: She followed us here.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...You let her follow you?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: We haven't exactly been dragging our feet, but she's kept up with us purely through her own skills, even after grabbing W's gear.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: She's an 'experienced' Sarkaz, and I may need a local guide when it's time to bounce.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: —Are you insane? Isn't that all the more reason to kill her right here?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: If you want us all dead, you might as well just do it yourself.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I wouldn't dare.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: What if she's an assassin? What if she leads us straight into a trap?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Did you forget how many people in Kazdel want your head?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Oh? How many?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...There's one right in front of you.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: You've got a huge bounty on your head. But for the time being, I'd rather it stay on your shoulders. Don't get too full of yourself.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I appreciate your diligence and frugality, but I'm not joking around either.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: She took the risk to pick up W's knife and gun, and had the stones to walk right up to us.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: What are your Arts telling you? Is she hostile?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...No sane person would just take in a totally unknown Sarkaz.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Yeah, that's the difference between you and me.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: On my way back, I gave her a whole bunch of openings, and she... threw little stones at me.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: An interesting display of good will, wouldn't you agree?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...Huh?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: According to the old ways, we might want to give her a chance.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: This war has thinned out our ranks. We could recruit some more Sarkaz, just as mysterious as her, but I'd rather hand-pick someone myself.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: But, she's an outsider. Our ways don't apply to—

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: —You know what, forget it.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: I'm leaving in ten minutes. I don't care how many come with me.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: But if you're gonna give me any more corpses to deal with, I don't care whose, you better make it quick.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Heh. Quite the impatient one, aren't you.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...All right, you. Listen carefully.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You're holding our fallen comrade's relics there.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Put them down, and you can walk out of here alive. You'll have to find somewhere else to die, but at least you'll buy yourself some extra time.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: This is your last chance.

steps.name: Disheveled Sarkaz Woman
steps.text: Last... chance?

steps.name: Disheveled Sarkaz Woman
steps.text: ...I don't think I ever had a choice. The second I turn around, you draw your blade and cut me down.

steps.name: Disheveled Sarkaz Woman
steps.text: This whole time... your other hand has been on that hilt.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...Very good.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You may have seen us before, or maybe you worked for someone else. None of that concerns me.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: But, you understand what it means to take up the weapons of the fallen, yes?

steps.name: Disheveled Sarkaz Woman
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: In that case, prepare to evacuate first. We'll talk details later.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Now, go rejoin the squad—
There is no end to war. And there is no end to our fight.
It is as if war is the tool that we have always relied on for survival.
...Mm, I am convinced of that.
Some still harbor reservations in their heart, while others have grown accustomed to that fact. The latter live, the former die.
And some people... were born to play this role.
What a pleasant surprise.
When I saw her in those crumbling ruins, I knew for sure...
She would reign supreme among the Sarkaz warriors.
